notes.title: 1.2 Update Notes - Level 3, Language Support and More!
notes.notes:
[h1]### 1.2 UPDATE ### [/h1]

This exciting update brings the following to Frustrating Platformer
[list]
[*] Language Support for: Chinese(Simplified), Russian and Spanish
[*] Colour picker for the player
[*] A whole new level
[*] New animations and mechanics
[*] Significant quality of life
[/list]

[h3]Language Support[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323143/95d80c11873aca33de19126ed93081fabc89c460.png[/img]
Language support can now be found in the Options menu. Portuguese, French and German can be expected to be added in the next update

[h3]Colour Picker[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323143/99b0c996f07ac18a2f23acd1c2d6e0c023d9e9cd.png[/img]
Now choose your colour from the in-game pause menu using the interactive colour picker!

[h3]New Level[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323143/b744a1a75ba3c1cbaac431097192449b92884572.png[/img]
This update also brings a whole new level! Tackle level 3, which introduces a new speed booster consumable and new challenges for you to triumph

notes.title: 1.1 Update Notes - Quality of Life
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added backgrounds to levels
[*]Added fullscreen or windowed mode toggle
[*]New animation for movement
[*]Fixed bugs relating to death counter
[/list]
A new Level 3 will be added in February along with the following language support:
[list]
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Russian
[*]Spanish
[/list]
A colour selector is also in the works
Thank you for your patience! :)
